scope: Index checks in the botlib's two navigation-file loaders, decided on and proven against every navigation file of every installed game: an offline measurement of every file with the loaders' own checks and loaders run over each, a load of every map with navigation, with bots on, before and after the change on the stable meson/build/win32-dev binaries, and damaged copies of four stock files run before and after.

rules.message: lump N is outside the file
rules.protects: a negative length wrapped the lump allocation (Hunk_Alloc refused -7); an oversized one allocated what the file does not hold

rules.message: is not an AAS file
rules.protects: a file shorter than its header left the rest of the header unset

rules.message: has no root node
rules.protects: every descent starts at node 1

rules.message: plane N has no opposite plane
rules.protects: traces turn a hit plane round (planenum ^ 1); the ladder test takes a face's back plane

rules.message: has N area settings for M areas
rules.protects: an area number indexes both tables

rules.message: node N has a bad plane
rules.protects: AAS_PointAreaNum, the traces and the entity link read it (fault observed at AAS_PointAreaNum+0x54)

rules.message: node N has a bad child
rules.protects: the same descents follow it (fault observed at AAS_PointAreaNum+0x4b)

rules.message: child C of node N leads back to that node or one above it / child C of node N is already below another node
rules.protects: a cycle never lets the point query, a trace or an entity link end (hang observed); a share multiplies an entity link's walk

rules.message: area N has a bad face range
rules.protects: trace-end face, ladder test, alternative routing and ET routing walk an area's faces; area 0 included

rules.message: face index N names no face
rules.protects: the face walks follow abs(index); 0 names the dummy, which RTCW's reader allowed

rules.message: face N has a bad plane / face N has a bad edge range / face N has a bad area
rules.protects: face tests, edge walks, alternative routing and clustering; from face 1

rules.message: edge index N names no edge
rules.protects: face edge walks follow abs(index)

rules.message: edge N has a bad vertex
rules.protects: face edge walks read both vertexes; from edge 1

rules.message: cluster N has bad area counts
rules.protects: routing sizes each cluster's caches and travel times by them

rules.message: cluster N has a bad portal range
rules.protects: routing walks a cluster's portals through the portal index

rules.message: portal index N names no portal
rules.protects: the same walk

rules.message: portal N has a bad area / portal N has a bad cluster
rules.protects: routing reads a portal area's settings and travel times and the clusters' caches; portal 0 included (RTCW fault observed at AAS_RemoveRoutingCacheInCluster+0x50)

rules.message: portal N has a bad number in cluster C
rules.protects: cache and travel-time index, bounded by routing only from above; portal 0 need only not be negative

rules.message: area N has a bad reachability range
rules.protects: routing lays out rows for every area's reachabilities, area 0 included, and reverses them

rules.message: area N has a bad cluster
rules.protects: indexes the clusters, or the portals by -cluster

rules.message: area N has a bad number in cluster C
rules.protects: indexes the cluster's caches

rules.message: area N is portal P, which is another area / portal P is area A, which is not that portal
rules.protects: routing hands a portal's two numbers to the area it names

rules.message: area N has reachabilities but no cluster
rules.protects: Quake III routing takes such an area through cluster 0 and portal 0; only in files with clusters, and not area 0

rules.message: cluster C lists portal P, which is not on its border
rules.protects: routing numbers each listed portal inside the listing cluster

rules.message: reachability N leads to a bad area
rules.protects: routing and movement index the areas and settings by it

rules.message: clusters hold more numbers than N areas and P portals can take
rules.protects: routing lays out a cache pointer for each number

rules.message: area N shares number K in cluster C with another area
rules.protects: a cache and a reachability offset kept for one area are read for the other, the offset up to 127 records past the table

rules.message: areas lay out more reachabilities than the file's N
rules.protects: AAS_CreateReversedReachability writes one link for each of an area's first 128 reachabilities into a table of one link a reachability

rules.message: routing would need more than 67108864 bytes of travel times
rules.protects: AAS_CalculateAreaTravelTimes sizes the table in an int

foundAlongTheWay: Quake III routing starts each area cache from startareatraveltimes[128] (AAS_UpdateAreaRoutingCache), indexed by the goal area's incoming links; mpq3tourney6 (134), two Quake Live files (up to 198, blackcathedral) and Elite Force hm_cam (355) exceed it, so routing to those areas reads past the array; RTCW uses the area's own row.
AAS_PointReachabilityAreaIndex reassigns cluster to a portal's front cluster and then reads portals[-cluster], a negative index, for every point in a portal area.

AAS_ReadRouteCache (Quake III maps/NAME.rcd) checks only counts and CRCs any file can match, then trusts each cache's size, area and cluster; no installed Quake III, Quake Live or Elite Force pak ships one; RTCW's reader validates its own.

AAS_Optimize, run only when the botlib writes a file it completed itself with aasoptimize set, remaps reachability face and edge numbers through the optimiser's tables, including the model numbers and velocities jump pads and movers keep there.
Quake Live's arcanecitadel fills the entity link's 128-entry stack (AAS_LinkEntity: stack overflow), before and after: its links are cut short, as the stack was designed to stop.
note: Damaged files are rebuilt from the installed file, used in a probe home and deleted; only hashes are kept.
